标题: Call for outright firework ban after Huyton night of terror
正文(前5000): Call for outright firework ban after Huyton’s night of terror Firefighters and police were targeted as they attended a blaze at Knowsley Heights last night People are calling for an outright ban on the sale of fireworks after several reports of misuse, including an incident which saw police and firefighters targeted whilst responding to a tower block fire in Huyton. Emergency services were called out to Knowsley Heights on Primrose Drive at approximately 7pm (November 5) after reports of a fire on a fourth floor balcony, according to Merseyside Fire and Rescue Service (MFRS). Firefighters quickly gained entry to the property and extinguished the fire, however MFRS released a statement soon afterwards confirming fire crews had been “targeted and attacked with fireworks.” Knowsley Heights is owned and managed by Livv Housing and is currently in the process of being decanted. However, the Liverpool ECHO understands the decant process is far from complete and a significant number of people still live there. Merseyside Police released a statement just before midnight, confirming it had rushed to Knowsley Heights following reports a group of youths were directing fireworks towards the buildings. On arriving, police said officers were targeted and fireworks launched in their direction. One officer was injured at the scene. Chief Inspector Kevin Chatterton said: “We will not tolerate this type of disgraceful behaviour, particularly when it involves emergency services staff being targeted in such a way. It is only by sheer good fortune that nobody was seriously injured.“ Police later arrested a 14-year-old boy on suspicion of arson with intent to endanger life. As details of the incident began to emerge, Knowsley Council published a strongly worded statement from Council leader, Cllr Graham Morgan, including a post on its official Facebook account. Cllr Morgan said: “I am shocked and saddened that our hardworking firefighters have been targeted maliciously whilst attending a call out.” Adding: “I condemn the actions of those who have needlessly risked the safety of residents and emergency workers tonight.” The Facebook post prompted almost dozens of comments from concerned members of the local community, many of whom called for an outright ban on the sale of fireworks. Lynn Gunn commented: “Please get them banned. My dog is petrified and she’s not the only one. “Ban them with immediate effect. Shut down fireworks shops that open all year and ban pop up shops also.” Claire Marsden added: “The way things are going they’ll be banned. There’s a reason that guns, knives, tasers, pepper sprays etc. were banned. “Certain people can’t be trusted, so things that can be weaponised are banned. What these [people] have done is weaponise something that was made for entertainment and cause harm to others.” Jo McIver said: “Absolutely disgusting. Ban the sale of fireworks, it’s that’s simple. I hope these [people] are found and punished for that. Grenfell springs to mind, thanks to the emergency services for responding so quickly.” Ronnie Birch wrote: “Never going to ban them and why will they, for a minority who can’t behave, not just on bonfire night, any other night of the year. Attacking the fire service or police when trying to do their job is unbelievable given what happened to Grenfell tower. “Knowsley Council could easily do organised events across the borough but probably say financially they can’t. So we’re back to square one again next year.” This sentiment was shared by Lisa Gaffney who suggested an outright ban was not the solution: “I don’t think it’s fair to ban fireworks, there’s enough government and councils to set a bonfire up safeguard it and supervise a display. “All fireworks are given to adults and anyone found to not follow the rules are removed. Kids love fireworks if used correctly.” She added: “Should bring back bonfire night run by the council then because it’s getting worse each year a kids keep getting everything we had as kids taken away. It was never like this? I just hope everyone’s ok.” In response to some of these points, Cllr Graham Morgan, Leader of Knowsley Council, said: “The local authority does not have the power to issue or enforce a ban on fireworks. There are however laws in place which restrict the sale and use of fireworks, which thankfully the vast majority of people adhere to. “Unfortunately for the small minority who do not, and who are intent on causing harm and fear, no amount of legislation or organised events will deter them. And that is why it is so important that these people are caught and feel the consequences of their actions. “We do not organise Council Bonfire events and haven’t for many years but we do and can support community groups who want to organise events safely. More information is available about this process on our website.”

标题: 汕头自建房火灾始末|楼房|陈辉|铺面|五金店|汕头市
正文(前5000): 事发五金店。澎湃新闻记者 陈灿杰 图 这是一栋典型的潮汕地区“三合一”自建房，一楼开五金店，二楼作仓储，三楼住着奶奶和父母，四楼住着兄弟三家人。 几十年间，临街铺面从三间扩容成五间，看着蒸蒸日上。 直到一场大火毁了所有。三代人经营的五金店没了，四代同堂的家族中，12人丧生。 12月9日晚，位于广东汕头潮南区峡山街道的这栋四层自建房发生重大火灾，潮南区消防救援大队发布警情通报称，过火面积约150平方米。 火灾发生后，澎湃记者实地走访发现，事发地所在的峡山街道丹凤路上，多为类似的“三合一”式建筑，即经营、仓库、住宿混合，多处一楼店铺闭门停业。 仍在营业的数家商铺经营者均提到，今年以来已接受多次消防检查，沿街店铺需配有喷淋、烟感、灭火器等消防设施，否则停电停水。然而，一名知情人士称，事发五金店此前已办理消防合格证，但更多可能是应付日常检查，“除了喷淋没水，烟感也不正常”。 12月10日上午，广东省政府召开全省安全生产和消防工作视频会议，要求深刻汲取汕头“12·9”自建房重大火灾教训，对立即开展重大火灾风险隐患排查整治行动进行动员部署。近日，澎湃新闻在当地看到，当地已有建筑在安装防火门，以将楼下经营场所与楼上区隔。 中冶建筑研究总院（深圳）有限公司正高级工程师闵红光博士向澎湃新闻表示，“三合一”自建房是火灾高风险区，因可燃物多，没有严格的防火分隔，缺乏必要的消防设施设备，“一旦起火，极易导致群死群伤”。他建议，应建立房屋安全档案并信息化管理，建立跨部门综合监管体系，对自建房进行每年不少于一次的定期检查。 “主要就是那个烟在冲上去” 邻居陈辉说，发生火灾的五金店一般开到晚上近11点，常能看到店主和儿子在店里喝茶，事发当天，他们恰好关门较早。 这家店名为裕丰五金电器店，吴先生是店主的大儿子，起火时不在家。当晚9点22分，他接到妻子电话，得知家中失火，随后紧忙报警并驱车回家。 他赶到店里时，是9点28分，妻子两臂拽着两个小孩从店后门跑出，十岁的大女儿则已经打开正门逃生，“头发还被火烧焦了”，大女儿“应该是被黑烟熏到眼睛，看不见，没有方向感，就往前面冲”。吴先生说自己两次尝试进入正门，都被浓烟呛了出来。他的另外三个孩子和其他亲人还在着火的房子里。 当时，住在五金店对门的林斌和街坊一起，从紧邻厂房的消防栓接消防水带灭火，但很快发现是杯水车薪，“主要就是那个烟在冲上去”。现场视频显示，透过该店临街一侧关着的木头正门，能看到店内有剧烈火光，浓烟滚滚。伴随店内响彻街头的燃爆声，火势瞬间冲出门缝。 据相关道路监控信息，9点24分前后，距五金店约4.6公里的峡山消防救援站出动了两辆消防车；9点32分，距五金店约2.2公里的峡山管区消防义务队出动了一辆消防车。另据多名参与救火的街坊回忆，报警后共有6辆消防车陆续抵达，除上述两支消防队外，还有距五金店约9公里的司马浦消防救援站派车支援。 当时，吴先生未逃出来的三个孩子躲在房子后侧三楼的防盗窗处，等待救援。 在五金店后门协助救火的邻居陈辉回忆说，当时楼下聚着近二十个街坊，还有人关心三个孩子的安危，用手电筒照着。消防员随后到场升起云梯，用工具剪掉窗外的防盗网将小孩救下。陈辉记不清救下三个孩子花了多长时间，“那个时候连颤抖和害怕的时间都没有，只是帮忙了”。 澎湃新闻记者在现场向陈辉核实，房子三楼处有破拆痕迹的防盗网，即3个小孩逃生处。房子其余各层窗户均有防盗网，部分设置了逃生口，但未打开。尚不清楚逃生口是否上锁，以及遇难者生前是否曾尝试打开。 吴先生回忆说，3个小孩获救后，他以为其他人都跑向了天台。楼内有两个楼梯，分别在楼中间（连接正门）与楼的一侧，均可直通天台，“没有隔断的，只需要一分钟，甚至三十秒都能上去”。而上到天台后有三扇门，“两个没锁，可以直接打开”。 最终，吴先生等来了最为痛心的结果。他得知，除他与妻儿一家八口幸存，其余12位亲人躲在厕所或房间内，全部遇难，包括他的奶奶、父母和两个弟弟及其家人。事后他重返楼内，发现火几乎没烧到楼上，“人是被烟呛死的”。他说，见到遗体时，有遇难亲人的眼睛“还睁开（着）”，他试着把他们的眼睛合上。 从起火到明火被扑灭，过去了43分钟。据汕头市潮南区消防大队发布的警情通报，火灾发生的具体时间是12月9日21时20分，接报后，消防部门迅速调派力量赶赴救援，22时03分，现场明火被扑灭。 事发后，澎湃新闻拍客曾进入火灾现场，发现楼上屋内家具完整，几株植物仍然存活，但阳台和室内烟熏痕迹明显。 高层自建房火灾，浓烟可能是导致死亡的重要原因之一。中国消防科普委员会专家委员刘祖河接受中国新闻周刊采访时说，一旦楼下起火，高温、浓烟和有毒气体沿楼梯急速上蹿，迅速吞噬逃生通道，留给楼上居民的反应时间和逃生空间都极为有限。 据微信公号“广东消防”文章，今年6月14日凌晨，汕头一四层自建房突发大火，4人丧生。调查发现，火灾起因是首层电气线路短路，飞溅的熔珠点燃了堆积的大量可燃物，火势迅速蔓延。事发时，住在三楼的奶奶被惊醒后，紧闭房门转到窗口呼救，最终成功获救。四楼的一家三口在慌乱中打开房门试图逃生，导致大量浓烟涌入，且退回时未及时关门，不幸丧生。 文章称，事发整栋楼仅有一部敞开式楼梯，且顶部被顶棚封死，形成了烟囱效应，浓烟无法排出，整栋楼很快沦为“烟罐”。而被困人员在逃生途中因烟雾阻隔被迫退回房间时，未第一时间关闭房门阻断烟雾侵入，导致有毒浓烟迅速涌入房间，最终因吸入性中毒窒息身亡。 曾多次检查 12月16日，澎湃新闻记者在现场看到，事发楼房主体为四层钢筋混凝土结构，一楼五间铺面相连，楼顶为半封闭式天台。 火灾后，该楼房二层外墙、窗户有明显烟熏痕迹，一层则用绿色彩钢板围蔽，消防、应急、公安等部门工作人员在彩钢板一侧的开口处登记后，入楼开展火灾原因调查工作。 多名在五金店买过东西的街坊称，一楼的店铺卖电机、铜线、漆罐和PVC管等五金材料，“塑料管一捆一捆包着”，此外还有灭火器等消防器材，二楼则摆放一些货物。 吴先生说，五金生意从他爷爷一辈就开始做了。1989年，他一家盖了楼，原本为三间铺面，之后扩建为五间。一家人四代同堂，共20人住在三楼和四楼。其中，奶奶、父母住三楼，他和两个弟弟及各自妻儿住四楼。 5年前，他在挨着五金店的后方盖了新楼，但一直没去住。“我老爸不让我们分家，可能是顾虑到家里小孩子太多了，照顾不了，要等小孩大一点（再分）。” 在起火建筑所在的峡山街道丹凤路，澎湃新闻记者观察到，沿街自建房基本为“三合一”式建筑，集经营、仓储、居住功能为一体。楼高4-5层，经营餐饮、建材、服饰等生意，不过事发后多家店已闭门停业。“有的是平时就没开，有的是需要整改不能开。”一名药店老板说。 根据政府信息公开显示，今年以来，峡山街道办事处开展过至少三次消防安全宣传活动。11月21日，峡山街道办事处发文介绍，街道有关负责人在活动中强调，各村（社区）要压实网格责任，聚焦“三合一”场所专项整治，加快隐患清零，织密防控防线。 此外，文章称，峡山街道排查各类场所超9000家，整改隐患1.3万余条，同步完成逃生窗口增设、电动车集中充电设施建设等硬件升级。 中冶建筑研究总院（深圳）有限公司正高级工程师闵红光博士告诉澎湃新闻，“三合一”自建房是火灾高风险区，多数缺乏消防设计，用电、用气、用水等管线的私拉乱接现象频发。且因可燃物多，没有严格的防火分隔，缺乏必要的消防设施设备，“一旦起火，极易导致群死群伤”。 此前，峡山街道曾发生“三合一”住宅起火。据汕头市潮南区应急管理局发布的情况通报，6月10日1时许，潮南区峡山街道西沟村一市场内铺面发生火灾，2时40分消防队扑灭明火，起火造成3人死亡。该铺面一层经营粮食销售，二层为居住用的阁楼。 当地数家商铺的经营者均提到，西沟村发生火灾后，消防及工商检查变得更为严格，“查了一个多月，来铺里查账、拍照、做笔录”。上述药店老板回忆说，此次五金店火灾前也有过几次消防检查，尤其是查灭火器。12月13日中午他接受采访时，正忙着让工人在一楼改装防火门，应急部门人员则在现场检查。 检查与“应付” 上述药店老板回忆，近六七年来，按照规定，至少在峡山街道丹凤路一带，周边的“三合一”房屋基本都安装了喷淋系统。他的门店所设喷淋系统由消防池供水，此外配有烟感、消防栓、应急灯等设施，且每年需更换新的灭火器。如果没按要求做，会被断水断电。 同路段另一家五金店老板向澎湃新闻称，有关部门不时会到店进行消防检查，“灭火器、烟感、应急灯，喷淋一定要安装，否则无法营业”。至于事发五金店里是否有喷淋系统，他称并不清楚。事发五金店邻居陈辉对此表示，“按理来说是要有的，很多年前开始，消防（要求）各户人家都要搞，他家上面都放着几个水塔。” 但当地居民王军表示，他有3个朋友就住在事发五金店旁，也参与了灭火，事后一行人至少两次复盘救援过程，均确认店内配有喷淋，但火灾发生时没水。 对此，吴先生回应澎湃新闻称，店里配有消防设备，“喷淋有没有接上水，具体我真的是不清楚”。他表示，自己常年在外做生意，五金店生意主要由父亲和两个弟弟负责，他很少过问。 一名知情人士称，事发五金店好几年前就办了消防合格证，烟感、消防门、喷淋都有安装，但更多可能是应付日常检查，“除了喷淋没水，烟感也不正常”。 王军在潮南区经商多年，自家有纺织厂房。他表示，通常厂房的消防检查更严格些，一般建厂打地基时，就要同时挖好消防池为喷淋供水。“三合一”房屋的喷淋主要靠楼顶加装水塔，按事发五金店的规模，最少要二十多吨水，四五只水塔才能达到要求，还需考虑房顶载荷。在多重因素下，有些“三合一”房屋可能会为了应付消防检查做表面功夫。 对于自建房隐患，闵红光认为，在城镇及“城中村”区域，应将自建房安全纳入基层网格化管理。明确网格员、街道、部门职责，定期排查结构安全、违法改扩建、违规经营等，建立房屋安全档案并信息化管理。 “此外，应建立检查制度。住建、消防、应急、街道等部门需加强协调，对自建房进行每年不少于一次的定期检查，以及在灾害天气前后的特定检查。”闵红光补充说，应构建自建房的安全长效机制，覆盖用地、规划、审批、施工、使用全链条，建立跨部门综合监管体系。 12月12日，吴先生向澎湃新闻表示，他一家人已转院至汕头市区的医院，几个小孩因呛烟及流感导致的肺部感染已有所好转，而他只能让自己一刻不停地忙着，处理家人后事。“我怕我不忙的时候会有回忆……以后房子搞好了，叫我在家里住我都不会去住。” （为保护受访者隐私，文中陈辉、林斌、王军为化名。感谢许跃为本文提供帮助。） 标题: Fires engulf Turkey Mediterranean coast , government declares disaster zones
正文(前5000): By ANDREW WILKS, Associated Press ISTANBUL (AP) — New wildfires broke out on Turkey’s Mediterranean coast Friday, as the government declared two western provinces in the country to be disaster zones. Images showed flames and smoke billowing into the sky close to high-rise apartment buildings in Antalya, where local and foreign visitors flock during the summer months. Homes were evacuated in the city center and the outlying district of Aksu as the fire advanced, privately owned news agency DHA reported. Firefighters struggled to extinguish the blazes before strong winds could spread the fire, which closed a major coastal road. Further along the coast, homes in the city of Manavgat were also threatened. Local residents with hoses and buckets rushed to assist firefighters as water-dropping helicopters and planes also battled the flames. Police water cannons and municipal water trucks were also enlisted in the firefighting efforts. Gaining control Antalya Gov. Hulusi Sahin said that the fires were under control apart from one in Aksu, which was “showing a tendency to grow,” and another in Gazipasa, east of Manavgat. “The fires were truly disturbing and dangerous, because they occurred in city centers, among houses,” he said. “We evacuated some of our homes … There are no deaths or injuries.” At 115 F, July temperatures in Antalya city were the highest for the month since records began in 1930. Interior Minister Ali Yerlikaya, meanwhile, said Friday that Izmir and Bilecik provinces had been declared “disaster areas affecting public life,” one step below the most serious level of emergency. Widespread evacuations Between June 27 and Thursday, residents from 120 neighborhoods nationwide were evacuated, Yerlikaya added, and more than 12,000 workers under the ministry’s authority, such as police and rescue staff, had fought the fires. In a social media post, the minister said 311 homes had been destroyed or seriously damaged during the monthlong blazes and 85 temporary housing units were set up across three western provinces for those made homeless. Speaking after Friday prayers, President Recep Tayyip Erdogan said that Turkey was “faced with a truly great disaster.” He said that 25,000 personnel were fighting fires across the country, assisted by 27 planes, 105 helicopters and 6,000 ground vehicles. Month of outbreaks Turkey has faced widespread outbreaks of forest fires since late June. Thirteen people have died, including 10 rescue volunteers and forestry workers killed Wednesday in a fire in Eskisehir, western Turkey. The funerals for the 10 were on Thursday. Temperatures above seasonal norms have been exacerbated by strong winds and dry conditions, resulting in dozens of wildfires. East of Antalya, fires broke out in Adana and Mersin on Friday. Elsewhere in the country, firefighters continued battling blazes in Eskisehir and nearby Karabuk that have been raging for several days. Albania battles fires The heat wave in the eastern Mediterranean region saw 1,000 firefighters and soldiers battle flames in Albania as temperatures reached 107 F. In the Albanian city of Elbasan, firefighters have been combating a weeklong blaze in the country’s central mountain forests. Fires have also broke out near the southern border with Greece. Cyprus aftermath In the aftermath of one of Cyprus’ worst wildfires in living memory, it wasn’t lost on Cypriot officials that climate change may have been a significant contributing factor to the pace and ferocity of the flames. Both government spokesman Constantinos Letymbiotis and Fire Chief Nicos Longinos referred to the arid conditions, with temperatures hitting 111 F and very strong winds that quickly overwhelmed fire crews. Even 14 firefighting aircraft couldn’t douse the multiple, fast-moving fire fronts quickly enough. Cyprus is in its third year of minimal winter rains on which it relies for drinking water and for agricultural purposes, even as the government is revving up additional desalination projects. The fire that moved at breakneck speed left two dead, forced the evacuation of 16 communities, scorched dozens of homes and destroyed many orchards and farms. Quizzed by a reporter about criticisms that the Fire Service didn’t move quickly enough, Longinos was on the verge of tears when he said that he and all his firefighters have taken an oath to “give their lives” if need be to save lives and property. Llazar Semini in Tirana, Albania, and Menelaos Hadjicostis in Nicosia, Cyprus, contributed to this report.

标题: NYPD officer killed in Manhattan shooting remembered as hero – NBC 5 Dallas - Fo
正文(前5000): The New York City police officer who was killed when a gunman opened fire in a midtown Manhattan building on Monday evening was a dedicated father and civil servant who was working a second job as a security guard, according to officials. Didarul Islam, a 36-year-old immigrant from Bangladesh, was the first person to be shot in the attack at 345 Park Ave. that left four others dead, including the gunman, authorities said. Watch NBC 5 free wherever you are Islam had been with the police department for about four years and leaves behind two young sons and a wife who is pregnant, according to the New York Police Department. “He was doing the job that we asked him to do,” NYPD Commissioner Jessica Tisch said at a news conference Monday night. “He put himself in harm’s way. He made the ultimate sacrifice, shot in cold blood, wearing a uniform that stood for the promise that he made to this city.” Create a free account with NBC 5 DFW to save articles and videos. She added that Islam was working off-duty through a police department program that allows companies to hire officers in uniform to provide extra security. Those who knew Islam said he “believed in living out the life of a godly person,” said New York City Mayor Eric Adams, who told reporters at the news conference that he had met with Islam’s family earlier in the night. “I told them that he was a hero, and we admire him for putting his life on the line,” said Adams, who is a former police officer. “He embodies what this city is all about. He’s a true-blue New Yorker, not only in a uniform he wore, but in his spirit and energy of loving this city.” Officials said the motive for the attack was still under investigation. Shane Devon Tamura, a 27-year-old from Las Vegas with a “documented mental health history,” has been identified by police as the gunman. Authorities say he recently drove cross-country to New York, storming into the office tower and spraying the lobby with gunfire before taking the elevator to the 33rd floor to fire more shots and then turning his weapon upon himself. Two officials familiar with the matter told NBC News that the shooter, who played football in high school, left a note at the scene that said he wanted his brain studied for chronic traumatic encephalopathy, or CTE — a neurodegenerative disorder associated with head injuries that has been diagnosed in hundreds of NFL players after their deaths and that can cause changes in behavior and cognition. The corporate building where the shooting took place houses the headquarters of the NFL, though it was not immediately clear whether the NFL was the intended target. One NFL employee was seriously hurt in the attack, according to the league’s commissioner, Roger Goodell. In addition to Islam, the dead include another security officer and an executive at Blackstone. Islam had been stationed in the lobby of the building close to where the gunman entered, officials said. The officer’s family remembered him as a loving father who was devoted to his religion. “When he had time, and especially his off-days, he went to the mosque with his two kids,” Muhammad Mainul Islam, who identified himself as Islam’s cousin, told NBC New York on Tuesday. Islam had been assigned to the 47th Precinct in the Bronx. The head of New York City’s police officers’ union said relatives described him as proud to put on the “uniform and shield of a New York City police officer.” “He went out every single day to provide for his family, whether it was overtime or whatever he had to do,” said Patrick Hendry, the president of the Police Benevolent Association. In a Tuesday morning interview on MSNBC’s “Morning Joe,” Adams said Islam was the first Bangladeshi-born NYPD officer to be killed in the line of duty. He and New York Gov. Kathy Hochul on Tuesday ordered flags on government buildings to be flown at half-staff in honor of Islam and the other shooting victims. 标题: Hong Kong tower fire toll rises to 128 , 200 remain missing
正文(前5000): HONG KONG: The death toll from Hong Kong's worst fire in nearly 80 years has risen to 128 and about 200 people remain missing from the high-rise residential complex that was engulfed by the blaze, the city's security chief said on Friday (Nov 28). The fire hit the Wang Fuk Court development, with eight 32-storey towers, in the northern district of Tai Po on Wednesday afternoon. Hong Kong Security Chief Chris Tang, speaking at a press conference, said fire alarms in the complex had not been working properly. Rescue efforts had now been concluded and at least 79 people, including 12 firefighters were injured, he said. The estate housing more than 4,600 people had been wrapped in bamboo scaffolding and green mesh for renovation work. Police said they had arrested three construction company officials on suspicion of manslaughter for using unsafe materials, including flammable foam boards blocking windows. GRIM TASK OF IDENTIFYING LOVED ONES While firefighters contained the blaze on Friday and doused the still-smouldering buildings, families had the grim task of looking at photographs of the dead taken by rescue workers. Mirra Wong, whose parents were living in Wang Fuk Court, was looking for news of her father. "Just recognise some picture is maybe (the) body of my dad. It's my dad's body is still missing here," said Wong, 48. Another resident, who did not want to be identified, said a friend's wife was among those unaccounted for. "Rationally speaking, it means there's no hope," she said. "But the bodies still have to be found, right? Let me see if they've found them ... It's just too sorrowful. When it involves people you know, it's even more painful." THE FIRE IS HONG KONG'S DEADLIEST SINCE 1948 Dozens of domestic workers from the Philippines had been caught up in the disaster and 19 were still missing, said Edwina Antonio, executive director at migrant women refuge association Bethune House. Indonesia's consulate said two of the dead were nationals also working as domestic helpers. Hong Kong has around 368,000 domestic workers, mostly women from low-income Asian countries who live with their employers. The fire is Hong Kong's deadliest since 1948, when 176 people died in a warehouse blaze, and has prompted comparisons to London's Grenfell Tower inferno, which killed 72 people in 2017. That fire was blamed on firms fitting the exterior with flammable cladding, as well as failings by the government and the construction industry. Police arrested two directors and an engineering consultant of Prestige Construction, a firm identified by the government as doing maintenance on Wang Fuk Court for more than a year. "We have reason to believe that the company's responsible parties were grossly negligent, which led to this accident and caused the fire to spread uncontrollably, resulting in major casualties," Police Superintendent Eileen Chung said on Thursday. Prestige did not answer repeated calls for comment. Police seized bidding documents, a list of employees, 14 computers and three mobile phones in a raid of the company's office, the government added. The city's development bureau has discussed gradually replacing bamboo scaffolding with metal scaffolding as a safety measure. Hong Kong's leader, John Lee, said the government would set up a HK$300 million ($39 million) fund to help residents while some of China's biggest listed companies announced donations. On the second night after the blaze, dozens of evacuees set up mattresses in a nearby mall, many saying official evacuation centres should be saved for those in greater need. People - from elderly residents to schoolchildren - wrapped themselves in duvets and huddled in tents outside a McDonald's restaurant and convenience shops as volunteers handed out snacks and toiletries. Hong Kong, one of the world's most densely populated cities, is scattered with high-rise housing complexes. Its sky-high property prices have long been a trigger for discontent and analysts say the tragedy could stoke resentment towards authorities despite efforts to tighten political and national security control. The leadership of both the Hong Kong government and China's Communist Party moved quickly to show they attached utmost importance to a tragedy seen as a potential test of Beijing's grip on the semi-autonomous region. - Reuters (US$1=HK$7.7779)

标题: 美以伊打仗 ， 为什么迪拜会  遭殃 ？_ 凤凰网
正文(前5000): 文/馍王 王动 编辑/章鱼 “迪拜国际机场T3航站楼被导弹碎片袭击”； “有母女花36万元囤12张机票，只为等回国”； “全球唯一七星级酒店迪拜帆船被无人机碎片击中”...... 刚刚过去的这个周末，关于迪拜的消息和中东战火紧密关联。 当地时间2月28日上午9点左右，美国和以色列突然联合对伊朗首都德黑兰和伊朗多处核设施实施了空袭。 这场突袭中，位于德黑兰的伊朗革命卫队总部遭到重创，伊朗最高领袖哈梅内伊在此次事件中直接死亡。 同日中午前后，伊朗革命卫队宣布将立刻针对此次袭击发动名为“真实承诺 - 4” 的坚决反击。革命卫队宣称，这将是历史上最猛烈的进攻行动，是美国和以色列对伊朗领土主权的侵略、意图颠覆政权的正当自卫以及合法报复。 然而，谁也没想到的是—— 距以色列直线距离2000多公里外的迪拜，成了这场反击中最先被波及的“倒霉路人”。 去迪拜避税的富豪，开始「避难」了 迪拜的受袭情况，比很多人想的严重。 3月1日凌晨，几乎所有站在迪拜市外的人们，都目击到了天空中星星点点的爆炸。 接下来，是手机上突然送达的警报，以及天空各处传来的隐约爆炸声。 这显然不是节日烟花，而是来自伊朗的大量导弹与无人机在飞越波斯湾的过程中，被阿联酋防空系统拦截的现场。 尽管阿联酋防空部队全力拦截，坠落的弹体碎片仍在迪拜多个核心区域造成了破坏。 迪拜的地标建筑棕榈岛费洛蒙酒店，被一块较大的坠落导弹碎片击中大门和庭院，并发生爆炸。 附近居民表示，在爆炸瞬间，周围建筑的窗户全部被震碎。 酒店门前燃起的大火，几小时后才被赶来的消防人员彻底扑灭。 在危险解除后，一位住户甚至在预订酒店的平台上给费洛蒙酒店打出了一星差评。 差评的原因很短：一颗火箭弹落在了我们房间里。 位于迪拜的世界最高建筑哈利法塔，也因为多次和被击碎的无人机擦肩而过，在28日当晚开启了建塔以来的首次人员疏散。 屡次爆炸的火光，将高塔的轮廓，映照得格外清晰。 号称迪拜“七星级酒店”的帆船酒店，频频因24K金装饰、海底餐厅、高空停机坪等配置在互联网露脸。 但即便是网红地标，也没能避免被导弹和无人机碎片波及。 酒店侧面在当日凌晨被击中并起火，客人被迫撤离到大厅避难。 危楼之下，不管多大的富翁们，都无差别地丧失了平日的特权和尊严。 他们披着浴袍坐在大厅椅子上，等待酒店下一步的通知。 在袭击造成的恐慌下，迪拜地区的居民陷入了混乱。 长居的人们纷纷进入超市扫货生活物资。 这两天的迪拜商场中，尽管主食、水等生活必需物资储备充分，但盐和冷冻速食产品早被抢购一空。 〓 图源小红书用户@殷殷In ArabLife 战火波及中，人的焦虑是具体的。 究竟是抢空货架上所有的奶粉，保证孩子未来几周的口粮，还是为其他妈妈也预留一些物资，成了互联网的热议话题。 现实与道德互搏的困境，在战火纷飞的夜晚并不少见。 但对于旅居迪拜的人来说，当务之急还是离开。 好不容易在崩溃的交通系统中来到机场的人们，则彻底傻了眼： 人到机场了，飞机却飞不出去。 中东地区多个国家关闭领空，截至3月1日凌晨，中东地区三个枢纽机场停止运营。 迪拜国际机场与阿勒马克图姆所有航班全面停飞。 〓 满屏“取消”字样的机场信息牌 更糟糕的是，迪拜国际机场T3航站楼被导弹碎片击中，航站楼里一度可以看到浓烟。 在袭击影响下，迪拜的航空系统彻底陷入瘫痪。 行李堆积如山的机场里，滞留了超过2万名来自各国的旅客。 千里迢迢来到“富豪之都”的他们，在餐厅和走廊中席地而坐，等待进一步的消息。 这其中不乏小孩孕妇，以及早已把药吃完的基础病老年患者。 机场停摆，机票也在涨价。 上周凤凰周刊编辑滞留三亚时，从迪拜转机回北京的机票只要1000多元。 但在危急关头，迪拜回国的经济舱票价已经涨到了1.2万元。 截至北京时间3月2日晚6:00，防空拦截仍在断断续续进行，迪拜全城仍处于紧急状态。 阿联酋国防部社交账号3月1日称，自2月28日遭受袭击以来阿联酋境内已有3名人员死亡，另有58人受伤，均已接受医疗救助。 不过，当地居民的心仍然被强烈的不安感紧紧缠绕着。 〓 图源小红书用户@路易妈妈迪拜生活✨ 迪拜的消息，不断出现在社交媒体。 这座花几十年慢慢构建的、以繁荣与安全著称的国际“富豪之都”，成为伊朗之外的另一互联网主要关注对象。 第一土豪城市、避税天堂......关于迪拜的所有神话似乎都在一夜之间像泡沫一样破灭了。 而战火的余波，仍在持续冲击着每一位市民与旅客的心。 富豪最爱的迪拜 为何会被伊朗「盯上」？ 在很多迪拜人看来，这波挨打，属于城门失火，殃及池鱼。 打仗的是美、以、伊，干迪拜什么事呢？ 事情还要从上周末说起。 2月28日，美国和以色列联合发动了对伊朗的大规模空袭。 仅仅一个周末的时间，美国和以色列就号称摧毁了伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队（IRGC）总部及其核设施、导弹工业中心等目标。 不仅如此，美以还对伊朗搞了一连串的斩首行动： 伊朗武装部队总参谋长穆萨维、伊斯兰革命卫队总司令帕克普尔、国防部长纳西尔扎德、最高国家安全委员会秘书沙姆哈尼等都在空袭中丧生。 当然还有最重要的，伊朗的最高领袖哈梅内伊，也已被美军定点清除。 〓特朗普宣布哈梅内伊已死 伊朗挨了这一连串打击之后，焉有不反击的道理。 周末，伊朗人也发动了代号“真实承诺-4”的军事活动，向美国、以色列目标发动了一系列反击。 美国和伊朗这些年的摩擦不少，互相开火也不是一次两次，但这次的确有点不同。 以往伊朗发动报复袭击前通常会提前预警，并明确告知将袭击哪些驻有美军的基地，出招之前先报名字，实际造成的损失有限。 但这次，伊朗不仅不预告了，而且袭击范围也大大扩大了： 卡塔尔、阿联酋、约旦、巴林、阿曼、科威特……有美军基地、被看作美国盟友的阿拉伯国家，都遭到了伊朗的报复。 〓 伊朗导弹击中以军总参谋部 伊方公布袭击图片 这其中，当然也包括迪拜。 虽然迪拜没有美军基地，但是迪拜的杰贝阿里港是美国海军在海外频繁停靠的补给中心； 位于迪拜以南的阿布扎比，有美军的达夫拉空军基地。 或许在伊朗看来，迪拜虽然没有直接参与，但也算是和美国、以色列有关。 伊朗扔了不少导弹，但实际上命中的并不多。 阿拉伯联合酋长国国防部3月1日发表声明称：自袭击开始以来，共监测到165枚射向阿联酋的弹道导弹，其中152枚被成功摧毁，13枚落入海中；2枚巡航导弹均被拦截摧毁。 此外还追踪到541架无人机，其中506架被拦截摧毁，35架落入境内。 事实上，虽然大部分导弹都被拦截了，但全网直播的拦截过程、掉落的导弹碎片、入境的无人机，还是让迪拜人心惶惶。 迪拜遇袭 为何能引起全球关注？ 在此之前，迪拜一直被看作海湾最吸引人的避税天堂、数字游民圣地、新兴富豪最爱的度假地…… 在局势混乱的中东，迪拜一直是“这边风景独好”的代表。 在极度依赖资源出口的中东，迪拜是少数成功实现了经济转型的地方。 迪拜的起点，和许多中东城市并无不同。 上个世纪60年代，迪拜发现了石油，凭借资源，挣到了崛起的第一桶金。 在 70 年代，石油曾占迪拜 GDP 的 50% 以上。但当时的老酋长拉希德（Sheikh Rashid）非常清醒，他曾说过一段传世名言：“我的祖父骑骆驼，我的父亲骑骆驼，我开奔驰，我的儿子开路虎，我的孙子也将开路虎，但我的曾孙可能又要骑骆驼。” 为了避免后代再度沦落到“骑骆驼”的窘境，迪拜很早就开始了疯狂的转型。 除了给国民发钱之外，迪拜很有前瞻性地在沙漠里搞起了大基建运动，出手就是超级工程。 要想富，先修路。 70年代，为了发展航运，迪拜酋长力排众议，在离市区 35 公里的沙漠里挖出世界最大的人工港口——杰贝阿里港。如今这里已经成为中东举足轻重的贸易港口。 有了港口，还要有机场。 虽然迪拜60年代就已经建成了机场，但是面积小、规格低，无法满足迪拜国际大都市的野心。在过去几十年，迪拜机场经历了一系列扩建，现在已经成了国际旅客吞吐量最大的机场。 有了硬件，还得有软件。 早在1985年，迪拜就建立了阿拉伯世界最早的自贸区，并做了一个堪称违背祖宗的决定：允许外资 100% 控股。 2002年，迪拜又建立了迪拜国际金融中心（DIFC），还在这里引入英国普通法体系，设立独立的法院，直接吸引了一大批国际金融机构入驻。 再加上零个人所得税、零利得税等政策，又让迪拜成了全球资本、数字游民和网红的避税胜地。 印度首富穆克什·安巴尼、Telegram 创始人帕维尔·杜罗夫、足球明星 C 罗、顶流网红“迪拜姐”…… 〓《福布斯》的调查显示有数十位亿万富豪在迪拜持有房产 在迪拜定居、旅居的富豪名人不计其数。 这里有世界第一高楼，有唯一的“七星级”酒店，全世界的豪车在街头出没，爱马仕不过是买菜包。 为这纸醉金迷的繁华背书的，是迪拜“中东最安全城市”的口碑。 众所周知中东是世界火药桶，生活在这里，天生就是与战争为邻。 但迪拜多年来却一直以安全、稳定的形象在海湾立足。 最重要的原因之一，就是迪拜一直奉行着弹性中立的政策。 〓现任迪拜酋长穆罕默德·本·拉希德·阿勒马克图姆 迪拜既是美国的盟友，参与了《亚伯拉罕协议》并积极与以色列建交，又是阿拉伯世界的一部分，和海湾邻居关系和睦。 即使是受到西方制裁的俄罗斯、伊朗等政权，也把迪拜当做资金的中转站和避风港。 去年一年，迪拜吸引了接近2000万国际游客； 在过去几年，迪拜一直是全世界最大的外国投资目的地； 迪拜的房地产市场，2024年交易额就达到了7610亿迪拉姆（约2070亿美元）…… 在袭击之前，金融、旅游 、房地产……迪拜的一切，几乎都在蒸蒸日上。 无数富豪在此置业，明星网红趋之若鹜。 如今，伴随着这场袭击，迪拜的一切都要重新估价了。 迪拜花了半个世纪摆脱了对石油的依赖，却无法摆脱对和平稳定的依赖。 一旦和平不在，卡拉也将不再OK。 标题: Three - alarm fire reduces Shelby apartment building to rubble
正文(前5000): SHELBY — Firefighters from several area departments responded Jan. 8 to a multi-unit structure fire on W. 4th Street in Shelby, between Michigan Avenue and Walnut Street, according to multiple agencies’ reports. Shelby Village Administrator Phil Morse said that DPW employee, Bradley Simons, was driving by the site that morning when he noticed smoke and called 911, then assisted in getting residents out of the building. No injuries were reported except for one instance of smoke inhalation. Chief Dean Roesler of the Shelby Police Department said that the building contained five units housing a total of eight residents, but not everyone was home at the time of the fire. “We’re pretty confident in the cause” of the fire, Roesler said. He explained that one of the lower-level apartments had a gas-powered wall heater as its primary heat source, which was improperly installed and had overheated the wall behind it. Compounding the problem was a “dead space” behind the wall which was adjacent to other units. Combustible materials ignited within that dead space, Roesler said, which “immediately drew the fire to the upper floors…And of course, it’s all old, dry wood.” After the fire was extinguished, all that was left was a pile of rubble. “That house has been remodeled multiple times, and added onto, and repurposed, and so there’s all these little spaces and nooks and crannies where the fire was hidden and still burning, and you couldn’t really get to it until you pulled walls apart,” Roesler said. “They basically had to pull it apart to get to stuff that was still burning, and once they pulled it apart so far, it became unstable and undesirable to leave the rest standing.” Mutual aid was provided by Grant Township Fire and Rescue, Ferry Township Fire Department, Hart Area Fire Department, Montague Fire District, Pentwater Fire Department, Life EMS Ambulance and Mason-Oceana 911, stated Shelby-Benona Fire Department on Facebook. The three-alarm Shelby apartment fire was just one of six calls for service that Shelby-Benona firefighters responded to over the course of three days, according to a separate post. “While the number may be small, the total number of hours was much greater, including three working structure fires and over 13 hours of structural firefighting and cleanup,” the agency stated. Essential fire safety tips for Michigan residents Michigan winters bring a perfect storm of fire risks: heavy heating use and space heaters, overloaded circuits and neglected chimneys. December through March are the most dangerous months for house and apartment fires. Here are some tips for staying safe in the winter: - Keep space heaters at least three feet away from anything that can burn. Fire officials say space heaters remain a leading cause of winter house fires statewide. - Plug space heaters directly into a wall outlet, never a power strip or extension cord. - Inspect furnace and heating systems early in the season; faulty furnaces can cause both fires and carbon monoxide issues. - Avoid overloading outlets; overloaded circuits are a major winter hazard in Michigan homes. - Replace damaged cords immediately. - Schedule a pre-winter electrical inspection, especially in older homes or rentals where wiring may be outdated. - Have chimneys cleaned and inspected annually. Neglected chimneys are a major winter fire source in Michigan. - Use a sturdy screen to prevent sparks from escaping. - Dispose of ashes in a metal container and store it outside, away from the home. - If you live in an apartment building, know your building’s evacuation routes. Keep exits clear of snow and ice. - Keep hallways and stairwells clear of clutter or space heaters. - Test smoke alarms monthly; replace batteries yearly. - Install carbon monoxide detectors on every level — CO risk is highest in winter when windows stay closed and heating systems run constantly. - Create a home escape plan and practice it with everyone in the household. - Keep fire extinguishers in accessible locations and ensure everyone knows how to use them. (Sources: countryherald.com, detroitmi.gov.)

标题: Rayner vows to pay any taxes owed over home purchase in resignation statement
正文(前5000): Angela Rayner has said the situation surrounding her resignation has been “incredibly tough” on her family, as she told MPs she will pay any taxes she owes. In a resignation statement, the former deputy prime minister said she would co-operate with HMRC, and said she hoped her situation would make families with disabled children aware of complex tax positions. Ms Rayner resigned in September after the Prime Minister’s ethics adviser found she had breached the ministerial code over whether she had paid enough stamp duty when buying a home in Brighton. She had referred herself to the standards watchdog for investigation after she admitted she had paid as much as £40,000 less surcharge than she should have done on the purchase in May. Sir Laurie Magnus, the Prime Minister’s ethics adviser, had found she had “acted with integrity” over the issue. Ms Rayner was emotional in the Commons as she spoke in the chamber for the first time since she stood down. Her voice cracked as she spoke about the Grenfell Tower fire survivors, as she made reference to the public inquiry. Ms Rayner, whose hands were shaking as she read her statement, said: “The last few weeks have been incredibly tough on my family, with my personal life so much in the public eye. All of us in public life know all too well the toll of the intense scrutiny we face places on our loved ones. “But I’ve always believed in the highest standards of transparency and accountability, and it is what the public expects and it is the price we pay for the privilege of service. “That’s why I referred myself to the independent adviser and gave them access to all of the information he needed. As I set out then, parents of a disabled child with a trust who divorce and seek different properties face a complex tax position. “If there is one good thing that can come out of this, I hope that other families in this situation may be aware of that, and avoid getting into the position that I am now in. “I am of course corresponding with the HMRC and they have my full co-operation. “There is no excuse not to pay taxes owed, and I will do so. This was an honestly made mistake, but when you make a mistake, you take responsibility.” Ms Rayner was sat next to Jim McMahon, a constituency neighbour who was sacked in the reshuffle that followed her resignation. Chancellor Rachel Reeves listened from the Government frontbench. Her successors David Lammy, and Steve Reed, who took over as Housing Secretary were also present. Bridget Phillipson, who is vying with Lucy Powell to win Labour’s deputy leadership election to replace Ms Rayner, was also in attendance. There has already been calls for Ms Rayner to return to Government since her departure. At Labour’s party conference in Liverpool, Health Secretary Wes Streeting told members: “We need her back.” On Wednesday, Ms Rayner recalled her maiden speech in 2015 when was elected as MP for Ashton-under-Lyme. She said “working-class communities” like hers were central to decisions she made when she was in Government – including its flagship Employment Rights Bill. Ms Rayner said: “I promised then to bring determination, commitment and my socialist values to this House while representing them, and I intend to continue to do so.” She said she had confounded expectations from people after being pregnant with her son aged 16. She said: “I know the power of politics to change lives because it changed my own. The last Labour government gave me the foundation to build a better life for me and my young son.” She added: “I was pregnant with my child, needing a job and a home. “People wrote me off, assumed that I would be on benefits the whole of my life. But I wanted to prove them wrong. “I’ve carried that with me, whether it’s on these benches, at the despatch box or representing this country abroad, the support and advice of so many friends and colleagues has kept me going.”

标题: Jason Moore murder case raised in House of Lords speech
正文(前5000): A bishop has given a speech to the House of Lords about the suspected wrongful conviction of Essex prisoner Jason Moore. Bishop Joanne Grenfell raised concerns about the murder case in her maiden speech, and called for a review of Britain’s miscarriage of justice watchdog to be urgently completed. “Any system worthy of public confidence must be able to correct and learn from its mistakes,” she said. Jason, from Clacton, was convicted in 2013 of murdering Robert Darby outside a pub in Ilford, east London. But, the bishop told the Lords, even Robert’s family are convinced Jason is innocent and want his conviction overturned. “I draw this house’s attention to the case of Jason Moore,” she said. “Both Jason Moore and Robert Darby’s families have spent the last 13 years campaigning to have that conviction reviewed. “Amid fiascos of lost evidence and problems with the management of identity parades and vital witnesses, Jason is still waiting for the Criminal Cases Review Commission (CCRC) to come to a decision about sending his case to appeal.” Bishop Joanne became involved in the Free Jason Moore campaign when she was Bishop of Stepney in east London. After meeting both families, she has joined them at a series of demonstrations, including outside Downing Street. She has since become Bishop of St Edmundsbury and Ipswich and was this year elevated to the House of Lords. Jason was charged and convicted of Robert’s murder after a single eyewitness picked him from a photo line-up seven years after the killing. No other evidence has ever connected him to the crime and the country’s top identification experts say the photo parade was improper and should never have been permitted. When retired Metropolitan Police detectives reviewed the case in 2020, they noted the witness had given a string of demonstrably incorrect details about the crime and suggested he be reinterviewed by the CCRC. But the CCRC refused, wrongly stating that two eyewitnesses had implicated Jason instead of one. When its error was pointed out, it refused to reconsider its decision. When a Newsquest investigative journalist found and interviewed the witness instead, he said he had been “drunk” when he witnessed Robert’s killing and was not sure he had identified the correct suspect. He added that he had told police from the outset that he’d been drinking. If true, that detail was hidden from Jason’s defence. The CCRC agreed in 2023 to look again at Jason’s case, but has yet to come to a decision. Since then, it has come under fire over its handling of the case of Andrew Malkinson, who spent up to ten avoidable years in prison due to CCRC failings. Mr Malkinson served 17 years for a rape he hadn’t committed, based on mistaken eyewitness identification. The CCRC repeatedly failed to test crime DNA which eventually not only exonerated Mr Malkinson, but helped catch the real rapist. The Law Commission is currently conducting a review of the CCRC, but Bishop Joanne called for it to be completed at pace. “The United Kingdom has long been seen as a standard bearer for the rule of law – yet even strong systems are not immune to error,” Bishop Joanne told the Lords on Monday (May 18). “When those errors lead to wrongful convictions, the impact is profound, not just for individuals but for confidence in the whole system.” Jason’s sister Kirstie attended the House of Lords to watch the speech. “I have lived every day of his sentence alongside him and it has come at immense personal cost,” she said. “In many ways the years taken from Jason have also been taken from me. There will never be words strong enough to express what Joanne Grenfell’s support has meant to me. “Her willingness to stand beside people such as Jason, Robert and both families, simply because she believes something is wrong, is something I will carry with me for the rest of my life.”

标题: Fire safety experts explain how Hong Kong inferno spread so quickly to multiple
正文(前5000): Fire safety experts explain how Hong Kong inferno spread so quickly to multiple towers - A fire in Hong Kong's Tai Po district, fueled by highly flammable bamboo and plastic scaffolding, killed at least 44 people and left nearly 280 missing. The towering inferno that burnt down multiple high-rises and killed dozens of people in Hong Kong was fuelled by highly flammable scaffolding material, fire safety experts said. At least 44 people died and nearly 280 were missing after a fire tore through several densely populated apartment blocks at the Wang Fuk Court residential estate in Hong Kong's Tai Po district on Wednesday. The death toll is the highest in a fire in Hong Kong since World War II, surpassing the 41 killed in a commercial building fire in the Kowloon district in 1996. With winds fanning the flames leaping out of seven buildings, the fire was not expected to be brought under control until the end of the day on Thursday. A concoction of factors led to the blazing inferno, including the dense development of the northern Tai Po district, home to 2,000 apartments in eight blocks housing over 4,600 people, experts said. A key factor was the flammable nature of the bamboo and plastic scaffolding covering the buildings, according to fire safety engineers. "The fire spread at the Wang Fuk Court housing complex is likely due to a combination of factors, including the plastic scaffolding encapsulation, plastic sheeting, polystyrene, the bamboo structural scaffolding, and any other flammable components," said Alex Webb, a fire safety engineer at Australia's CSIRO. In the wake of the fire, Hong Kong authorities arrested three men from a construction company, including its two directors and an engineering consultant, on suspicion of manslaughter. "We have reason to believe that the company's responsible parties were grossly negligent, which led to this accident and caused the fire to spread uncontrollably, resulting in major casualties," police superintendent Eileen Chung said. The incident immediately drew comparisons to the 2017 London Grenfell Tower inferno that killed 72 people. Experts called for strict oversight of construction materials in such densely populated cities, including the use of fire-resistant scaffolding systems. In the case of the Hong Kong inferno, the use of highly flammable bamboo scaffolding in particular caused the rapid spread of fire, they said. "Many factors could have contributed to this, including the scaffolding, which may have provided a 'highway' for the fire to travel vertically, and a warm nest for embers from adjacent structures to ignite," said Anwar Orabi, a fire safety engineering lecturer at The University of Queensland. "The bamboo scaffold acted as a continuous external fuel path. Dry culms have high surface-area-to-mass ratios and, when wrapped with plastic mesh, create a ventilated 'chimney' that supports rapid flame spread," added Ehsan Noroozinejad, a specialist in smart resilient construction at Western Sydney University. Engineers called for replacing bamboo scaffolding with a metal one to prevent such disasters in the future. "Mitigating this fire risk is feasible, as metal scaffolding has long been used in many countries and could readily be adopted. By eliminating the use of bamboo scaffolding, the risk of extensive building damage and human fatalities could be dramatically reduced," said professor Guan Yeoh from the University of New South Wales. "It's time for change - to remove outdated practices and adopt modern methods of fire safety and protection. Bamboo scaffolding is highly flammable, and strict building regulations should be imposed to ban its use," Dr Yeoh, an expert in fire-resilient infrastructure, added.

标题: Death toll rises after attack on Kyiv apartment building
正文(前5000): The death toll from a Russian missile attack that flattened a Kyiv apartment building had risen to 24, including three teenagers, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said. Mr Zelensky made his comments as he led the mourning for one of the deadliest attacks on the capital in the four-year-old war. The cruise missile hit the nine-storey corner apartment block on Thursday during what the Ukrainian air force said was Russia’s biggest barrage on the country of the full-scale invasion. Emergency workers finished digging through the rubble searching for victims after more than a day, Mr Zelensky said on X. Crowds of grieving people — many of them children — streamed towards a makeshift memorial beneath a tree near the destroyed building. Teenagers clutching bouquets arrived in groups and broke into tears as they approached the growing mound of flowers and stuffed toys beside photographs of the dead. A portrait of a girl in a school uniform, posed against a bright-yellow backdrop, was among the photos. Mr Zelensky and other top government officials visited the site to pay tribute to the dead, as did Kyiv-based foreign diplomats. Russia has hammered Ukraine with large-scale aerial attacks in the days since a May 9-11 ceasefire that US President Donald Trump said he asked Mr Zelensky and Russian President Vladimir Putin to observe. Fighting continued over those 72 hours, although reportedly on a lesser scale. This week’s attacks run counter to recent suggestions from Mr Trump and Mr Putin that the war is close to ending. The assault mostly targeted the Ukrainian capital, where 48 people were wounded, including two children, Mr Zelensky said. He said Moscow had launched more than 1,560 drones against Ukrainian population centres since Wednesday, adding that about 180 sites across the country were damaged, including more than 50 residential buildings. Previously, the biggest Russian drone attack was on March 23-24 when Moscow’s forces fired nearly 1,000 drones and missiles at Ukraine. Thursday’s death toll in Kyiv approached one from July 2024, when 32 civilians were killed and another 85 injured. Ukraine has also built up significant long-range capabilities, and Russia’s defence ministry said on Friday that its air defences downed 355 Ukrainian drones overnight in one of the largest barrages of the war. Several airports suspended flights overnight because of the attacks. A Ukrainian drone struck Ryazan, a city about 60 miles (100km) south-east of Moscow, and killed four people, including a child, regional governor Pavel Malkov said. 标题: Grenfell Tower handprints to be preserved after legal threat
正文(前5000): Parts of Grenfell Tower with handprints are planned to be removed and preserved following a legal threat from bereaved families. The move comes after handprints were discovered in a tower stairwell and identified as being of “profound evidential, historical, and emotional significance for bereaved families and survivors” to the families and survivors. It is believed the handprints were imprinted during the night of the June 2017 fire. Karim Khalloufi, whose sister Khadija was among the 72 people who died in the fire, said: "These sections on the walls in the stairwell hold the voices of that night—and we will not let them be erased, silenced, or this tragedy be sanitised. "History must record what happened." During a visit to the tower last summer, families reportedly saw the handprints and asked that the affected sections be preserved. The request was initially denied, according to the Grenfell Next of Kin group. This led to a legal letter being sent to housing secretary Steve Reed. Following the intervention, the government has paused demolition in those areas while it works to preserve the handprints. A spokesman for the Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government, said: "Grenfell Tower has a deep personal significance to the community, and we are committed to ensuring what happened at the Tower is remembered, with the community’s voice at the heart of our work. "We remain fully committed to handling elements of the Tower with utmost care, sensitivity, and respect. "In response to proposed legal action, we have paused deconstruction in the relevant areas and are taking steps to remove and preserve the requested elements, as far as it is practicable to do so." - The London pub with a blue plaque marking RAYE's 'greatest heartbreak' - All the deals in London this National Lottery week - Can you give one of these adorable pups a forever home? Work began to demolish the 24-storey tower in September 2025 and is expected to take two years. Confirmation of demolition earlier that year was met with criticism from some bereaved families and survivors. Some said they felt their views had not been considered. Others had hoped the tower would remain standing until charges were brought against those deemed responsible for the fire. In a February 2025 government update, then-housing secretary Angela Rayner was said to have "concluded that it would not be fair to keep some floors of the building that are significant to some families, whilst not being able to do so for others and knowing that, for some, this would be deeply upsetting." She had considered engineering advice which said the tower was significantly damaged and that the condition of the building would worsen over time. Engineers were also said to have advised it would not be "practicable to retain many of the floors of the building in place as part of a memorial that must last in perpetuity". The government has not yet decided whether the preserved handprint sections will be incorporated into the official memorial. The spokesman said: "We understand that families hold a range of views on that issue, and further consultation and engagement will be required." A final decision on their future will follow additional consultation with the community. The memorial project is being led by Freehaus, a design firm announced in November as the team selected to create a lasting tribute to the victims. Freehaus is working closely with bereaved families, survivors, and the wider community. The final memorial design is expected to be revealed in mid-2027.

标题: Firefighting at Hong Kong blaze ends with deaths over 90 , dozens missing
正文(前5000): Rescue efforts at Hong Kong blaze end with deaths at 128, dozens missing Police arrest three construction company officials on suspicion of manslaughter linked to the building renovation. Firefighting and rescue operations at Hong Kong’s deadliest blaze in decades have ended, a government spokesperson said, with the death toll rising to 128 and about 200 people still missing. Hong Kong security chief Chris Tang said on Friday that rescue efforts at the residential development have now wrapped up. The eight-tower Wang Fuk Court estate in the northern district of Tai Po, which houses more than 4,600 people, had been undergoing renovations and was wrapped in bamboo scaffolding and green mesh when the fire started and quickly spread on Wednesday afternoon. Police said they had arrested three construction company officials on suspicion of manslaughter for using unsafe materials, including flammable foam boards blocking windows. Late on Friday, the South China Morning Post reported that the city’s anti-corruption body has arrested six more people. On Friday morning, firefighters continued to work at the still-smouldering complex. “We’ll endeavour to effect forcible entry to all the units of the seven buildings, so as to ensure there are no other possible casualties,” Deputy Fire Services Director Derek Chan told reporters early on Friday. Al Jazeera’s Jessica Washington, reporting from outside the residential complex, said firefighters have been going through each of the apartments on Friday trying to find any trapped residents. “The community is in a deep state of grief,” she said. Chan said 25 calls for help to the Fire Department remain unresolved, including three in recent hours, which would be prioritised. “Hope they can find more survivors in the building. I think they had tried their best; the firefighters have done a lot,” resident Jacky Kwok said. “It is a terrible disaster that no one wanted to happen.” Rescuers had battled intense heat, thick smoke and collapsing scaffolding and debris as they fought to reach residents feared trapped on the upper floors of the complex. On Thursday, a distraught woman carrying her daughter’s graduation photograph searched for her child outside a shelter, one of eight that authorities said were housing 900 residents. Most of the victims were found in two towers in the complex, while firefighters found survivors in several buildings, Chan said, but gave no further details. Two of the dead were Indonesian nationals working as domestic helpers, the Indonesian consulate said. Hong Kong has about 368,000 domestic workers, mostly women from low-income Asian countries who live with their employers. The fire is now Hong Kong’s deadliest since 1948, when 176 people died in a warehouse blaze, and has prompted comparisons to London’s Grenfell Tower inferno, which killed 72 people in 2017. Hong Kong’s leader, John Lee, said the government would set up a 300-million Hong Kong dollar ($39m) fund to help residents, while some of China’s biggest listed companies announced donations.

标题: Private Jet Plunges Onto Texas Roadway After Reporting Mechanical Trouble , Kill
正文(前5000): A business jet reporting mechanical problems to a nearby airport crashed and caught fire on a Texas highway, killing one person and sending motorists racing from their cars to help rescue passengers from the burning wreckage. The plane went down late Tuesday in Laredo, Texas, near the Mexican border after its crew radioed the local airport seeking to make an emergency landing. Police said six people were on board and one of them died in the crash. The jet barreled into a car, sending one motorist to a hospital in stable condition. The cause of the crash was not immediately known. The FAA and the National Transportation Safety Board are investigating. The pilot radioing air traffic controllers “mentioned low fuel and a power outage,” said Laredo International Airport Director Gilberto Sanchez. “They had mechanical issues and they lost communication with the tower,” Sanchez said Wednesday, “and that’s when the accident happened.” Cellphone video from the chaotic scene showed motorists rushing to rescue those inside the jet. One swung a sledgehammer to try to smash open the cockpit glass. Others used makeshift levers to pry open the plane’s door as the fuselage burned. Dashcam video posted on social media showed the aircraft careening down the highway, knocking down a light post before coming to a stop near the Laredo International Airport. The plane, a Cessna Citation Latitude twin jet, departed Tuesday evening from the Mexican resort city of San José del Cabo and was bound to Austin, Texas, the Federal Aviation Administration said in a statement. The plane was operated by NetJets, a company owned by Warren Buffett’s Berkshire Hathaway that lets people buy part ownership in private jets. NetJets said in a statement it was cooperating with authorities. The plane crashed on the Loop 20 highway in Laredo shortly after 10 p.m. Tuesday, said Jose Baeza, an investigator with the Laredo Police Department. Video posted to social media showed the plane on its side, smashed into a highway barrier with the tail ripped from the fuselage. “It looked like part of a movie. I was in shock,” said Zayra Garza, an esthetician who was driving her co-workers home when she came upon the crash. Garza, who shot video of the scene as her husband ran to help, saw motorists leave their cars to try to help smash the cockpit glass. She said the plane’s door opened and three people who looked like teenagers rushed out, followed by someone who appeared to be a pilot. Another crew member tried to pull out a person who seemed to be unconscious. Smoke billowed from the plane as a firefighter climbed into the aircraft to rescue the remaining passenger. Police officers helping prop open the door had to back away as they doubled over coughing because of the intense smoke. Police said five officers were treated at a hospital for smoke inhalation. “What was worrying me was the fire,” Garza said. “I was concerned that it could have just exploded at any time.” This was the third significant aviation accident in as many days. A B-52 crashed Monday during a test flight at Edwards Air Force Base in California and killed all eight people aboard, while on Sunday, 12 people were killed when a plane on a skydiving outing in Missouri crashed. (AP)

Russia and Ukraine have continued to occasionally swap prisoners of war, and 205 from each country returned home Friday. Zelenskyy said it was the first phase of a planned 1,000-for-1,000 prisoner swap. 标题: Man arrested in connection with deadly West Side fire
正文(前5000): Man charged in deadly West Side fire appears in court CHICAGO (WGN) — A man who was arrested and charged in connection with a West Side fire that left four people dead, including a young child, appeared in court on Saturday. Four people, including a young child, were killed in the fire that police have confirmed to be arson. Three others, two adults and a little boy, were hospitalized in critical condition. A seventh victim, a woman who was unaccounted for following the fire, was found dead the next morning. Cook County coroners identified the victims as 32-year-old Gina Henry, her 5-year-old son Jayceon Henry, 28-year-old Destiny Henry, and 76-year-old Brad Cummings. On Friday, July 11, Chicago police announced 23-year-old Lontray Clark had been arrested in Springfield on Wednesday, July 9 in connection with the deadly fire. Clark has since been charged with the following offenses: - Four felony counts – Murder – First Degree  - Four felony counts – Murder – Strong Probability of Death/Injury  - Four felony counts – Murder – Other Forcible Felony  - Two felony counts – Arson – Aggravated Arson/Know Person Present  - Two felony counts – Arson – Aggravated Arson/Bodily Harm  - Two felony counts – Attempted First Degree Murder  - One felony count – Residential Arson  During Saturday's court hearing, prosecutors say Clark saw a photo on Snapchat of a woman he used to date inside his friend's apartment. Clark then allegedly filled an anti-freeze container with gasoline and bought a mask and long-sleeved shirt before setting the building on fire. The man and woman Clark allegedly targeted survived. "The arrest could never replace the lives that were lost," Rev. George Smith Jr., who lost three of his cousins in the fire, said. "This has been a senseless crime. It has been something that should have never happened, and if that was the case, he should have been man enough to just walk away." Clark also has a prior felony conviction related to a firearms offense. Clark's public defender says he has a three-month-old and claims she hasn't seen video identifying him near the scene. Smith says Jayceon, Gina and Destiny all lived in the same apartment with the women's 65-year-old mom, who was injured and survived. "My aunt, she lost her children. Her children were her everything," Smith said. "We're sticking close together. It's a day by day process. We trust God." Destiny Henry's four-year-old son, Kyle, who also lived in the apartment, is still recovering in the hospital. He is sedated with injuries including head trauma and burns, according to prosecutors. "He's getting better but he sustained some tremendous injuries," Smith said. Smith says his family is in the midst of an uphill journey as funeral arrangements for his cousins are pending. The fire originally happened at around 2 a.m. Thursday, June 26, at an apartment building located in the 5200 block of West North Avenue in Austin. Clark was denied pre-trial release by a Cook County judge. He is scheduled back in court on July 14. Copyright 2025 Nexstar Media, Inc. All rights reserved. 标题: Penny Lancaster reveals she almost left Rod Stewart over one major decision
正文(前5000): Sir Rod Stewart and Penny Lancaster seem to have a love so strong that nothing can come between them. And yet, the former model revealed that the pair almost went their separate ways after a disagreement about having children together, with Rod already being a father to six kids at the time. The duo first met in a bar in 1999 and went on to marry in 2007, yet it took some convincing on Penny's part for the legendary singer to be open to the idea of welcoming another child into his life. Speaking to Saga, Penny revealed that she would've walked away from their relationship if Rod had stuck by his decision to not have more children. "And that would have been very hard. But we just went with the flow," she recalled. The rocker changed his tune eventually, and they went on to welcome sons Alastair, 19, and Aiden, 14. "Now Rod always says, 'I wish I'd said yes [to babies] earlier, because then we could have had more children,'" Penny continued. "Even five years ago, we were talking about adopting, but it ended up not happening. We thought there might be too much of an age gap." The TV personality slyly added: "Actually, I have three because there's another big baby who needs my attention in a different way. I think all women would say that about their husbands." Rod and Penny may share a 26-year age gap, but their marriage appears to be stronger than ever. Speaking to HELLO! about their deep connection, the "Forever Young" singer shared the secret to their long-lasting love. "We love life and make date nights for one another, among touring and family time," he said. "We listen to each other and try to resolve all our disagreements, the dirty laundry, as Penny says, right away, and before we go to bed." As for his wife, Penny shared that being attracted to Rod is key. "You need a healthy attraction. Rod and I can have dinner in a crowded room or just the two of us – we always have eyes for each other," she explained. "There's this look, this connection, this message without words." They renewed their vows in 2017 at their Essex estate in a romantic ceremony. The proceeds from the event were donated to the victims of the Grenfell fire in London. Penny is now a proud stepmother to Rod's six other children, Sarah, 61, Kimberly, 46, Sean, 45, Ruby, 38, Renee, 33, and Liam, 31. "Being a stepmother to start with was very daunting and challenging, but it's proved to be an honor and very rewarding," she told HELLO! "When I first met my husband 15 years ago, his youngest was five and the oldest was 21. So I got to see the different stages that children go through and the challenges they hold, but the rewards as well." She continued: "It's been a learning curve, but a wonderful one. It's so lovely that we're all so close and they all turn to me for advice, to talk about dad, boyfriends and career choices. It's a big happy family now."

老式牌匾横躺在地下。几个红卫兵正在将新的牌匾挂在原来的位置 。红色背景金色字体 ‘太阳升百货大楼 ’  的新式牌匾替代了原来的牌匾。今早新闻报道，在南岗区的秋林公司改为 ‘东方红百货大楼’， 两个连着一起就是 ‘东方红，太阳升’。围观的年轻人看起来都很兴奋，他们对新生事物充满冲动和好奇。可是几个老人则目光呆滞，不断的摇摇头，感到惋惜。红卫兵挂完新的 牌匾之后，他们试着踩碎旧牌匾，三个人在牌匾上蹦，用力的跺脚，可是这个牌匾非常坚实，一点都没有踩碎。           秋林公司的斜对面是外文书店。外文书店坐落在十字路口，它是一座五层的巴洛克式建筑。在建筑的二层有一男一女两个裸体雕塑柱，这两个雕塑柱支撑着三层的阳台，使建筑和雕塑融为一体。从三个方向都可以看到雕塑。它是中央大街标志性建筑，也是哈尔滨最有代表性，最富有艺术性的优秀建筑。很多外地游客都会在这里拍照留念。          一辆消防车停在外文书店外，很多人围观。我看到消防车立刻联想到着火，于是我对小美说，“ 书店可能着火了。我们也去看看。”         小美也说，“ 肯定是着火了，否则消防车不会来。”         我们旁边的一个女孩好奇的听我和小美对话，她插话说，“ 如果是着火怎么没有烟？很奇怪呀？”             经她这么一说，我也觉得奇怪，怎么没有烟？我和小美面面相觑，等着看看究竟发生了什么。          不一会儿，一群红卫兵从消防车上下来。消防车的云梯缓缓升起， 上面站着一红卫兵拿着锤子。云梯靠近雕塑停了下来。红卫兵举着锤子向空中挥舞一下，然后砸向雕塑。他的举动引起围观者的一片哗然。我和大家一样感到万分的震惊。因为今早的新闻里没有提到要砸雕塑。接着红卫兵第二锤第三 锤砸向雕塑。大理石雕塑非常的坚固，红卫兵的锤子没有让它受到任何损坏。但这个红卫兵不服气，仍然非常的用力砸。他试了几次都没能砸坏雕塑。他脸朝下对着下面的人群说了些什么。然后另一个红卫兵拿着一把凿子上前递给他。他左手拿着凿子，右手拿着锤子，看看巨大的雕塑，最后他瞄准了女性雕塑的乳房，凿下一块。他觉得很有成就感，继续一点一点地砸，把女性雕塑两个乳房位置砸的乱七八糟。         八月的哈尔滨很热。我们都穿着夏装，他却穿着红卫兵的草绿色仿军装， 并扎腰带。我看不到他出汗，但能看到他不断的用袖子擦着额头。云梯缓缓的落下，另一个 红卫兵替换下他。 这个红卫兵接着上一个红卫兵的动作，对男性雕塑的下半身做了同样的事情。最后，他把雕塑砸的没有性别之分了。他觉得很成功，兴奋地在云梯上挥动锤子和凿子。地上的红卫兵抬头看着他，欢呼起来： “破四旧立四新！ ，砸烂旧世界，建设新世界！”          云梯缓慢的收起。红卫兵走出云梯，他和地面的红卫兵握手。过一会，消防车开走了，围观的人们也离开了。                  一晃 ，中午了 。因为一直仰视着观看 ，脖子累的酸疼 。我用手揉着后脖颈对小美说 ，“ 你累不累？”         小美说，“ 我是又累又饿 。”         我说 ，“ 我们回家吃午饭，下午再来怎样？” 小美同意我的建议。   待续 标题: Melanie Diaz Act : Montgomery County strengthens fire safety laws after Silver S
正文(前5000): Melanie Diaz Act: Montgomery County strengthens fire safety laws after Silver Spring death SILVER SPRING, Md. - New legislation was introduced in Montgomery County on Saturday to enhance fire safety standards and improve firefighting equipment, years after a Silver Spring woman was killed in a fire at her high-rise apartment. Honoring Melanie Diaz's legacy The backstory: Melanie Diaz was killed in a fire at her apartment building in 2023. Investigators said the fire alarm never went off, and the sprinkler system wasn't sufficient to control the flames, costing Melanie her life. Her family returned to Maryland this weekend from Florida, determined to make sure no other family has to suffer the same loss. What they're saying: "We promise to my daughter and to the community to fight every single day," said Cesar Diaz, Melanie's father. "Life is priceless. You can replace a house or a car and everything. You cannot replace a life." Melanie's brother, Cesar Alejandro, said he was angry after his sister died, "angry at the people who did nothing to prevent this. Angry at the people who continued to do nothing." The Melanie Diaz Act What we know: So, Melanie's family turned their grief into action. Working closely with Montgomery County leaders, they advocated for new state and local fire safety legislation, called the Melanie Diaz Act. The act strengthens tenant rights by requiring building management to inform residents of emergency plans, and providing 24-hour access to a building representative during emergency situations. PREVIOUS COVERAGE: Family who lost daughter in Maryland apartment fire takes part in emotional bill signing Meanwhile, more than 70 residential high-rise buildings in Montgomery County still lack full sprinkler protection, the most of any county in the state. The Diaz family also supported fire and rescue operational changes designed to improve survival, like adding sprinklers, working smoke alarms, fire-resistant corridor doors and more. On top of that, the Diaz family donated $10,000 to purchase smoke evacuation masks, which give victims critical extra time to escape from a building fire. "Thanks to the extraordinary generosity of the Diaz family, every fire engine, every ladder truck and every heavy rescue squad in Montgomery County will now be equipped with evacuation smoke hoods," Montgomery County Fire Chief Corey Smedley said. The family said that Melanie wanted to make a difference in the world, and that this is how they're helping her do that. What we don't know: FOX 5 did reach out to the apartment building where Melanie was killed for comment, but no one was available to talk. The Source: Information in this story is from the Montgomery County Fire Department, the family of Melanie Diaz and previous FOX 5 reports.

标题: Kolonos Apartment Fire : Woman Final Cry for Help
正文(前5000): ‘Help, help, I’m drowning!’ — those were the desperate cries heard from a woman found dead alongside a man in an apartment fire in Kolonos, Athens, early Saturday morning (18.04.2026). The blaze broke out under unclear circumstances around 4:30 a.m. on the third floor of a residential building on Argous and Platonos Streets. Panic, Screams, and Rapid Spread According to eyewitnesses, loud voices and a violent argument were heard coming from the apartment shortly before the fire erupted — some even reported sounds of furniture being thrown. Residents described scenes of panic: the woman was seen pounding on the door and shouting for help. Minutes later, flames became visible from neighboring apartments. Emergency Response and Tragic Outcome Firefighters responded immediately with four vehicles and a specialized aerial ladder platform. They managed to extract both individuals unconscious from the smoke-filled unit. Shortly thereafter, their deaths were confirmed. Victims and Background The apartment belongs to an elderly woman who has lived in a nursing home for several years; her son had been residing there. Authorities are currently identifying the male victim — believed to be around 50 years old — with assistance from his aunt, who is present at the police station. Neighbors say both victims were substance users. A neighbor recounted: ‘We heard voices around 5 a.m., then a fierce argument between the man and woman — things crashing, like furniture breaking. Then I heard a woman banging on the door, screaming “Help, I’m drowning!” I went out onto my balcony to see what was happening and heard people in the hallway talking to her, so I went back inside. But the banging and screams continued — then I smelled smoke. I got up and left. I live in the adjacent building, on the first floor. By about 5:20 a.m., we realized something serious was happening. By 5:30, flames were already visible. We saw it start in the right-side apartment on the third floor and quickly spread to the one on the left.’ Footage and Further Details News site newsit.gr has published video footage showing the rapid escalation of the fire in the Kolonos apartment. Neighbors clarified that the woman found with the man was not his sister — but his partner, also approximately 50 years old. For safety reasons, other residents of the building were evacuated. The fire caused extensive damage to the structure. The cause remains officially unknown. Investigators are exploring all possibilities — including a potential gas leak — while the reported altercation prior to the blaze adds further complexity to the case.

标题: 广州青年集体婚礼在白水寨举行 88对新人集体  撒糖 _ 广州日报大洋网
正文(前5000): “瀑见草坪”爱心大合影。 新人们在正果老街互动。 崇山峻岭与白水仙瀑共同见证新人们的“海誓山盟”。 新人们携手走过“派糖甜蜜花门”。 昨日，在“520”浪漫节点来临之际，“甜蜜派糖 修成正果”广州青年集体婚礼于增城区白水寨风景名胜区与正果老街温情启幕。来自部队官兵、医护人员、公安干警、科研人员、人民教师等各行业领域的88对青年佳偶，齐聚环南昆山—罗浮山县镇村高质量发展引领区（广州）腹地，在青山飞瀑下许下相守誓言、喜结连理；在认养“同心树”的仪式中，共同发出“守护绿美家园”的爱情宣言；在青砖黛瓦的见证下，携手穿越正果老街牌坊，演绎了一场从“甜蜜派糖”到“修成正果”的专属“广式浪漫”。 11年爱情长跑 终于在正果“通关” 站在派潭镇白水寨风景名胜区“瀑见草坪”上，便可遥望中国大陆垂直落差最大的瀑布、落差达428.5米的“白水仙瀑”。集体婚礼仪式就在此举行，崇山峻岭与白水仙瀑共同见证了新人们的“海誓山盟”。 坐直升机、按下囍印 这波仪式感直接拉满 “‘派潭’谐音‘派糖’，让我们向新人‘派发’幸福的糖果，让爱情的甜蜜从这里出发，流淌进你们未来的每一个日子。”聆听着充满祝福的证婚词，新人们携手走过“派糖甜蜜花门”，在特制的、融入派潭设计元素的婚书上共同按下爱情囍印，留下独一无二的爱情纪念。在喜气洋洋的氛围里，新人齐声许下对彼此的誓言，在青山绿水间走向幸福生活。两对新人搭乘直升机飞越白水寨，直达仙姑天池，在青山之巅手持结婚证合影留念、为爱祈福。 “这场集体婚礼，不仅让我们免去了复杂的筹备工作，还能和有缘人共同拥有一场甜蜜、浪漫、绿色的婚礼记忆，简直是为我们量身定做的幸福计划，让婚礼真正回归‘爱’的本质。”新人钟智远和袁艳在来之前就对集体婚礼活动有着很高的期待，当天的“仪式感”更是满足了他们此前的种种畅想，“所有新人互相见证着携手入场、交换誓言，这种集体承诺的庄严和浪漫是独一无二的。” “我们俩总是奔赴在一线，谈恋爱都像在执行联合任务。”天河区东莞庄路消防救援站副站长刘陈洋笑着说。他从事了十余年的灭火救援及各类事故灾害处置工作，而爱人胡慧萍作为广东广播电视台记者也不遑多让，总是奔赴在各个报道的第一线，“我守护岁月静好，她记录时代脉搏，殊途同归。”刘陈洋说，去年两人全身心投入十五运会和残特奥会相关工作中，暂缓了婚期“进度”，如今正好借此机会一同迈入婚姻殿堂。 认养“同心树” 让爱情像树木一样常青 现场，88对新人喜结良缘，伴随着一首首情歌，以爱成婚、携手成家。有喜事，种棵树。在白水寨的“喜事林”里，新人们用山泉水浇灌自己认养的同心树，系上誓言丝带、悬挂许愿祝福卡片，记录下对今后婚姻生活的美好期许，希望感情如树木般常青常盛；不少新人还在卡片上写下了与低碳环保相关的绿色婚礼宣言，决心在家庭中践行绿色低碳生活方式，共建绿美广州。 在正果镇，新婚夫妻逐对携手漫步穿过正果老街东门楼，并在“修成正果”打卡点拍照留念，随后开启了各自的甜蜜BINGO幸福打卡之旅：探访老街上的甜蜜小店，体验非遗蓝染的岭南传统文化，品尝正果本地的美食小吃、打卡艺术空间的绿植美学…… 记者发现，复刻岭南知名园林“可园”风貌的观景塔融入爱情元素设置双人打卡点，吸引了众多青年上楼俯瞰老街与增江美景。此外，步入正果镇“甜蜜经济”新地标圆角楼，其一楼布置了中西式婚服、文创产品的婚恋文化展厅，吸引游客驻足；二楼则新引入了增城区民政局婚姻登记处，将婚恋登记仪式与古镇文旅体验深度融合，为到此结婚登记的新婚夫妻打造独一无二的甜蜜仪式感。 当天早上，来自增城的青年黄伟豪和廖敏怡成了在圆角楼二楼婚姻登记处第一对领取结婚证的新人，正式为这场11年的爱情长跑翻开新篇章，让“来正果，让爱修成正果”从美好寓意变为现实见证。 戎装与婚纱同框 家国情怀最浪漫 在今年的广州青年集体婚礼中，有多位青年官兵和退役军人携伴侣参加。他们身着戎装，与爱人携手步入集体婚礼现场，为守护万家灯火的职责注入幸福的意义。 谭剑雄是一名现役军人，从谈恋爱时就与爱人蒙敏芝聚少离多。“我深知，我的肩上是家国使命，而她的肩上是对我的理解与支持。”谭剑雄说：“在这场温馨的集体婚礼上许下誓言，是我给爱人最庄重的承诺。能和战友们一起迈入人生新阶段，意义非凡。” 省军区政治工作部相关负责同志表示，此次发动青年军人参加集体婚礼，旨在进一步做好暖心惠兵工作，助力官兵收获人生幸福，更加心无旁骛投身练兵备战。 共青团广东省委与省军区联合开展广东省5·20军地共建青年集体婚礼暨“有喜事 来种树”活动，全省设广州、佛山、肇庆、中山四个活动会场。“甜蜜派糖 修成正果”广州青年集体婚礼为广州会场活动；肇庆会场于5月17日组织100余名武警官兵等青年开展集体婚礼、婚恋交友、共植“同心树”等活动；佛山将于5月22日组织超600名新婚青年到“环两江先行区”的九江海寿岛开展种植“同心树”、环岛骑行、集体婚礼等活动；中山将于5月23日组织100名青年官兵共同开展集体婚礼、植树、粤BA中山主场观赛等活动。 “婚恋+文旅” 激活甜蜜经济新动能 为助力打造青年发展友好型城市的“甜蜜样板”，广州共青团将以举办青年集体婚礼活动为契机，依托增城“甜蜜派糖”“修成正果”甜蜜经济品牌，推出消费礼包及甜蜜打卡路线，拓展“甜蜜经济”消费场景，在环南昆山—罗浮山县镇村高质量发展引领区试点建设“青春发展型社区”。 主办方介绍，本次活动精心策划了两条“派糖正果·蜜糖BINGO”游玩推荐路线。其中，“派潭遇甜·森系漫享”路线串联起白水寨景观坪、上九陂美丽庭院特色村、熹上茶咖等点位，带动新人们在天然“氧吧”中放松身心，并联动国际高端家电品牌卡萨帝打造甜蜜市集点位，新人们可以在“家的智慧场景”里沉浸式感受“一屋两人三餐四季”的浪漫爱意；“正果寻缘·老街甜心”路线则串联起东门楼牌坊、修成正果打卡点、温室效应植物艺术空间、圆角楼婚恋文化展示等，以轻松游玩为“甜蜜经济”加码。 对“00后”新人陈嘉豪和陈芊晓来说，此次集体婚礼活动从庄重的誓言到轻松的游玩，再到收到特色甜蜜礼包的惊喜，种种动人瞬间共同组成了两人的专属甜蜜回忆。当天参加仪式的新人均获赠由增城区国有资产经营集团提供的甜蜜礼包，内含增城好礼、非遗文创等10样礼物，寓意婚姻生活“十全十美”。 文、图/广州日报全媒体记者张姝泓 通讯员穗团宣

标题: 三位首都产业一线科技人才走进华电 ， 讲述电力科技自主创新故事 新京报
正文(前5000): 风、水、阳光等清洁能源如何跨越千山万水成为电？在马路上奔跑的标注有“FCEV”的车辆与普通新能源汽车有何不同？9月28日，在有着“电力行业的黄埔军校”之称的华北电力大学（下称“华电”），来自新能源领域的三位首都产业一线科技人才结合自身经历，为该校师生们讲述了中国电力科技自主创新的故事和如何为百姓生活中的“电”保驾护航。 这是由北京市委教育科技人才工作领导小组主办的“社会主义是干出来的 新时代是奋斗出来的”——首都产业一线科技人才走进高校系列宣讲专场之一。9月中旬至10月中旬，36名产业一线科技人才组成的宣讲团，将走进21所高校，讲述科研报国初心，激发青年使命担当。 9月28日，来自新能源领域的三位首都产业一线科技人才走进华北电力大学分享。图/华北电力大学 三位科技人才生动讲述产业一线故事 从冬夏不同工作状态下穿的衣服，到解暑神器“十滴水”，再到带电作业的历史，王月鹏用一个个小故事描述了高压线上“电力手术师”的日常。今年46岁的王月鹏是国网北京昌平供电公司配网不停电作业室班长，他曾研制国内首套含引流线预处理功能的全自动具身智能机器人，填补配电带电作业领域技术空白。 国网北京昌平供电公司配网不停电作业室班长王月鹏。图/华北电力大学 “1998年刚参加工作时，我跟着师傅学用绝缘杆作业。”王月鹏提到，这个时期的作业方式能做的事情非常有限。此后随着绝缘斗臂车的普及，电力一线工人的作业方式有了改进，作业人员可以穿上全套绝缘服站在斗臂车内，能直接接触带电体，操作的灵活性大幅提升，但危险系数也增加了。如何既能保持灵活性，又能确保安全距离呢？王月鹏最后将绝缘杆与绝缘平台结合，推动了“基于绝缘平台的绝缘杆作业法”落地。多年来，王月鹏累计获得20项国家专利、发表19篇论文，参编5部专业书籍及8项行业及企业标准， “这些创新成果，凝聚着团队的智慧，也让我明白，创新从来不是孤军奋战，而是需要分享和传播的火种。” “同学们，当你们走在城市的大街小巷，是否注意到越来越多的绿色牌照汽车穿梭于车流之中？”北京亿华通科技股份有限公司副总经理方川用日常生活中的细节开启了当天的分享，他提到，新能源车辆中，已有不少氢燃料电池汽车的身影，其中搭载的燃料电池系统就是自己一直科研攻关的对象。 北京亿华通科技股份有限公司副总经理方川。图/华北电力大学 方川回顾了自己的个人成长经历，他自本科阶段起就开始参与氢能与燃料电池相关的研发工作，入职后开展了从30kW到300kW的系列化燃料电池发动机产品开发。现场，方川还特意展示了两张珍贵的照片，一张是亿华通初创时期工程师们穿着摩托车手厚皮裤、脚贴暖宝宝坚持研发调试，另一张是自己在清华搭建实验台的场景，以此告诉学生们，研发条件早已今非昔比，自己也在一次次突破技术瓶颈的研发中不断成长。“我坚信，中国的氢能事业不仅能‘干出来’，而且一定能干好、干出一流水平！” 国网北京市电力公司高级工程师、高级技师王庆灏分享时表示，新疆的风、张北的光之所以能顺利成为绿色的电，这背后全靠“电力高速公路”特高压。王庆灏已在特高压一线工作了十一年，从一名大学生成长为特高压工程师，其中既有无数电力前辈的触动，也有自己在铁塔下、在导线上磨出来的各种经验。 国网北京市电力公司高级工程师、高级技师王庆灏。图/华北电力大学 王庆灏在现场提到自己在北京冬奥会期间的一个创新故事。为了实现对北京冬奥组委“全部场馆100%使用可再生能源”的承诺，国家电网要建设一条专为新能源送电的柔性直流通道，这就是张北柔性直流工程。但是绿电要进城，要越过官厅水库。“一级水源保护地、流沙层、水下暗流，像在鸡蛋上盖房子。”王庆灏从吃饭时使用的“双层冰杯”中找到了灵感，创新性采用双层旋转管护筒，并通过钢栈桥搭设，解决了施工库区设备通行的问题。 真诚分享将成为课堂教学生动的课程思政素材 “你们是新时代的‘带电体’，浑身奔涌着青春的电流。希望你们带着‘敢干’的闯劲、‘会干’的巧劲、“实干”的韧劲，在各自的领域成为不可或缺的‘关键一相’。” “氢能的未来，充满无限可能与机遇。它需要更多年轻的力量加入其中，需要你们用专业知识和技术创新，共同推动这场深刻的能源变革。” “大家要多跑现场，难题到现场找，专利也从现场‘抠’。图纸上的线条不如塔上的螺栓真实，实验室的数据不如导线的温度滚烫。” 分享最后，三位产业一线科技人才也纷纷对着学生们说起了“掏心窝子话”。 贴近专业知识的故事讲述、真情实感的一句句嘱托、令人振奋的科技创新经历……三位产业一线科技人才的分享让这群未来的“电力人”“新能源研发者”深感共鸣，并不时鼓掌。 三位产业一线科技人才的分享引发学生共鸣，并不时鼓掌。图/华北电力大学 该校新能源学院硕士研究生谢雨飞告诉记者，自己的研究方向也是氢能，“方川老师的分享让我感受到，因为一代代科研工作者不断攻坚克难，才有了我们现在的能源格局。”今年暑假期间，谢雨飞曾在暑期社会实践中进入企业一线，“我参访的企业已经在制氢、储氢、用氢上完成了绿色用电的零碳闭环。像这样跟一线企业、一线科技人才的实际交流，会对我的研究有很大的帮助。”未来，谢雨飞也想像方川一样，在自己的领域精耕细作，为祖国的绿色事业贡献自己的力量。 听完三位产业一线科技人才的讲述，该校电气与电子工程学院大一新生杨灵畅很是感慨，“无论是严寒还是酷暑，电力人都要进行高空作业。听完这段我就觉得电力工作者非常有奉献精神。虽然工作环境很艰苦，但他们把自己投身到国家建设之中，而且十分自豪。我也被他们这种自豪感所感染，这也是我以后想要成为的样子。” 与此同时，这场生动的分享会也为学校教师提供了素材。 华北电力大学能源与动力机械工程学院教授翟融融说，三位产业一线科技工作者将个人理想融入党和国家发展的需要，把科研创新写在服务人民的实践中。“无论基础研究的突破，还是工程技术的创新，背后都有坚定的理想信念作为支撑和引领，这种胸怀家国、矢志报国的精神境界，让我深受教育和鼓舞，也为我的课堂教学提供了生动的课程思政素材，我将把他们的故事融入课堂教学中，引导学生把个人成长同国家战略需求结合起来奋发学习、刻苦钻研，为科技强国贡献青春力量。” 标题: 践行雷锋精神 上杭古田  火焰蓝  绘就为民服务暖心画卷 - 龙岩今日要闻
正文(前5000): 东南网龙岩3月17日讯（本网记者 马伊骅 通讯员 邓观文）闽西红土沐春风，雷锋精神永传承。在古田会议精神的发源地——龙岩上杭古田，上杭古田“火焰蓝”始终坚守初心、躬身为民，成为红色圣地温暖的底色。 近日，福建省委宣传部正式公布2026年福建省岗位学雷锋标兵名单，其中，龙岩市上杭县古田消防救援站入选“福建省岗位学雷锋标兵集体”。这份荣誉，是对这支驻守红土17载的青年消防队伍的又一重要肯定，更是他们以雷锋精神为帆，以为民服务为桨，在灭火救援、便民奉献、圣地守护路上步履不停的生动见证。 自2009年建队以来，古田消防救援站的指战员们将古田会议精神与雷锋精神深植心底，把“人民消防为人民”的誓言化作一次次逆行、一回回帮扶、一件件实事，先后获得“全国119消防先进集体”“全国青年文明号”等30余项殊荣，让雷锋精神在闽西红土地上生生不息、灼灼生辉。 实干担使命 硬核守护筑牢平安防护墙 践行雷锋精神，不仅是暖心的点滴付出，更是关键时刻挺身而出的责任与担当，为民服务的最深层内涵，莫过于用过硬本领守护一方平安。 驻守红色圣地，既要做群众的“贴心人”，更要做景区的“守夜人”， 古田消防救援站以实战砺精兵、以硬功护平安，把雷锋精神融入主责主业，用坚守与担当为老区群众的生命财产安全保驾护航，让“平安”成为最厚重、最实在的为民答卷。 作为全国重点文物保护单位、国家5A级景区，古田会议会址以传统砖木结构为主，消防安全防护难度极大。为守护这片红色圣地，古田消防救援站组建的“防火巡逻队”，每日穿梭在景区的青石板路、老区的街头巷尾，敲门入户开展消防安全巡查，用接地气的方言向群众普及防火常识、紧急避险和自救逃生技巧。 建队17年来，防火巡逻队”累计发放消防宣传资料10万余份，精准查改火灾隐患500余处，不仅实现了古田会议旧址群核心景区“零火灾”的纪录，更守住了辖区火灾“零伤亡”的底线，为红色圣地筑起了一道坚不可摧的消防安全“防火墙”。 训练场的汗水，是守护平安的底气；实战中的冲锋，是为民服务的担当。面对训练场地、设施受限的局面，古田消防救援站的消防员把毛主席纪念园的台阶当作训练塔，把营区周边的空地当作练兵场，以实战化练兵锤炼过硬本领。 消防员资英琼便是队伍中的“尖兵标杆”，改革转制以来，他连续两届登上全国“火焰蓝”实战化比武竞赛的“国字号”舞台，获评“全国消防救援队伍训练标兵”，而他的成长，正是这支队伍苦练本领、勇攀高峰的缩影。 2024年6月，在龙岩上杭遭遇特大暴雨，古田消防救援站全体指战员枕戈待旦、闻汛而动，全力营救和疏散转移受灾群众，为居民冲洗房屋街道，连续奋战至灾情结束。 截至目前，古田消防救援站累计接警出动1500余次，成功抢救疏散被困群众600余人，在龙岩“7.12”卓越新能源油罐爆燃、泉州“3.7”酒店坍塌事故等一系列急难险重任务中，指战员们向险而行、逆火冲锋，用血肉之躯为群众筑起一道道安全屏障，用实际行动诠释了“赴汤蹈火、竭诚为民”的铮铮誓言。 作为红色圣地的特殊消防队伍，古田消防救援站还肩负着古田会议旧址、毛主席纪念园的礼仪保卫重任。17年来，队伍累计执行毛主席纪念园重大礼仪勤务2500余次，接待包括党和国家重要领导人在内的各界人士6万余人次。 红土践初心 暖心服务织就民生幸福网 在古田会议会址景区的核心区域，“红军茶屋”的红色招牌格外醒目，一杯热茶、一句指引、一次援手，这里不仅是游客的“歇脚点”，更是群众的“暖心港”。 作为古田消防救援站践行雷锋精神、深耕为民服务的鲜活阵地，“红军茶屋”与“红色驿站”、“红星长廊”共同勾勒出红土消防的便民服务版图，让雷锋精神的温暖流淌在每一个角落。 依托红色圣地的地域特色，古田消防救援站创新推出免费提供休息场所、解渴茶水、应急药品、景区向导、义务讲解的 “五项承诺”，把便民服务送到群众最需要的地方。据统计，建队以来，该站累计为游客和群众提供暖心服务22万余人次，小小的 “红军茶屋” 里，AED 除颤仪、速效救心丸等应急物资常备不懈，成为守护生命的“移动应急仓”；一张张热情的笑脸、一次次耐心的讲解，让这里成为景区独有的“温情名片”。 2024年3月，一名老人在 “红军茶屋” 突发心梗，正在茶屋外普及消防安全知识的古田消防救援站消防员罗桂林闻声而动，以百米冲刺的速度奔回营区取来急救箱和 AED 除颤仪，跪地开展心肺复苏、送上急救药品，成功将老人从生死线上拉回。 让专业与温度相融，让服务与传承同行。古田消防救援站的指战员们不仅是赴汤蹈火的“战斗员”，更是红色故事的“宣讲员”。站内全员苦练讲解技巧，培养出一批优秀的义务讲解员，消防员韦克周便是其中的佼佼者，10年来，他站在古田会议广场，为上万名游客娓娓讲述古田会议的红色故事，让革命精神随消防蓝焰传递四方。 雷锋精神，贵在日常，重在坚守。古田消防救援站组建的“学雷锋小分队”，始终奔走在老区的街巷村落、田间地头，成为红土地上的“暖心使者”。他们深入敬老院，为孤寡老人理发、剪指甲、打扫庭院，细致排查用火用电隐患，手把手讲解灭火器材使用方法；走进贫困家庭，送上米面粮油等生活物资，为困境学子送去学习用品，用点滴行动传递温暖与希望。 建队以来，“学雷锋小分队”累计走访居民家庭600多户，为困难群众捐款3万余元、捐赠衣物300余件，与辖区60余名孤寡老人、失独家庭、老党员结成“亲情牵手”帮扶对子，资助20余名困境学生完成学业，让雷锋精神在一次次真诚帮扶、一次次无私奉献中，在闽西红土落地生根、开花结果。 从救援现场的一次次逆行到“红军茶屋”的暖心服务，从红色景区的日夜坚守到敬老院里的一抹温情，从义务讲解的一腔热忱到扶危帮困的一份初心，古田消防救援站的青年指战员们，始终将古田会议精神与雷锋精神深度融合，以 “红军草鞋精神” 铸魂育人，让每一名指战员都成为雷锋精神的传承者、实践者和倡导者。 未来，古田消防救援站将继续赓续红色血脉、践行雷锋精神，把为民服务的初心融入每一次出警、每一次帮扶，以青春之躯守护群众平安，让“火焰蓝”的光芒在闽西红土愈发璀璨，书写新时代消防救援队伍为民服务的崭新篇章。
